title: The eager-closure gate's header still renders the RETIRED ceiling/baseline pair as "3.07 MB" and "3.12 MB" — both have been false since `639114c4d`
body:
Found while taking the live measurement objectui#7848 was dispatched for (tip `72bcd7783`, commit date 2026-09-10T10:13:32Z). ⛔ Not fixed there: that dispatch fenced its write to one specific class, and this is a different sentence. Filing rather than riding it in.

## The defect

`scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`, module header, three lines:

- `:208` — "This is a truthful CURRENT-STATE ceiling, not a target. 3.07 MB gzipped before first render is a bad payload …"
- `:213` — "Nothing here should be read as a finding that 3.12 MB is acceptable."
- `:215`-`:217` — "The two figures in that paragraph are one constant each, rendered in MiB, and not a contradiction: 3.07 MB is BASELINE's measured payload and 3.12 MB is MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES, the ceiling standing over it."

That last sentence binds each literal to a named constant, so it is checkable. Checked:

| constant | value on `72bcd7783` | rendered MiB | what the prose says |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `BASELINE.gzipBytes` | 3,551,191 | **3.39** | 3.07 |
| `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` | 3,597,000 | **3.43** | 3.12 |

The two literals are the **retired** pair, exactly: 3,222,314 / 1048576 = 3.0730 and 3,268,000 / 1048576 = 3.1166. Decimal MB does not fit either figure, and the paragraph itself says "rendered in MiB", so there is no reading on which they are current.

## When it broke, traced rather than inferred

`git show` of the file at four commits:

| commit | commit date | `MAX` | `BASELINE.gzipBytes` | prose |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `565817a72` | 2026-09-06T00:30:27Z | 3,268,000 | 3,222,314 | 3.07 / 3.12 — **true** |
| `639114c4d` | 2026-09-07T07:31:44Z | 3,597,000 | 3,551,191 | 3.07 / 3.12 — **false** |
| `9de7758de` | 2026-09-07T09:40:37Z | 3,597,000 | 3,551,191 | unchanged |
| `452f1f779` | 2026-09-10T09:43:43Z | 3,597,000 | 3,551,191 | unchanged |

So the maintainer-authorised re-baseline of objectui#7685 moved both constants and left both renderings behind. Four days and three subsequent edits to this file have not touched them.

## Why nothing caught it

The prose pin added by objectui#7528 (`scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts`, "chunk counts in this gate's prose") matches CHUNK POPULATIONS only, and its own docblock says the size class is out on purpose: "The workflow's frozen-SIZE prose is a DIFFERENT class and is deliberately OUT of this pin — named here so nobody widens a count pin into a size pin by accident."

⇒ This is that deliberate gap producing its first instance in the checker itself. ⛔ This card is **not** a request to widen the pin — that trade was already weighed and declined, and the same docblock explains why.

## The repair this file's own rules point at

⛔ Refreshing the literals to 3.39 / 3.43 restarts the clock the file has already been burned by four times (objectui#7518, objectui#7046, objectui#6778, objectui#7528). The header states the alternative in its own voice, on the bullet objectui#7529 rewrote: "⛔ No figure is restated here: this bullet carried one and it went a whole re-baseline stale."

⇒ The fix that matches the file is to **stop restating the two constants in MiB** and let the paragraph name its subjects — which is all objectui#7528 asked of it in the first place ("Saying which is which is the whole of this note"). Docs-only, comment lines only, no constant moves.

## Scope notes

- ⛔ No constant moves on this card, in either direction.
- Nothing here bears on the live margin; that measurement is on objectui#7848 and it passes.
- Same class as the two repairs objectui#8956 landed in this file on 2026-09-10, and as objectui#8579 before it — a fact a constant-moving commit did not carry, recorded afterwards.

Filed unassigned, unlabelled, for triage.

This card was written by an agent seat (Claude Code) during the objectui#7848 measurement run; that attribution is stated here as prose because a footer block does not survive issue creation.
